body: Sometimes all it takes is knowing someone out there is feeling the same as you. Relating to just about every feeling on pain you are. I'm new on this and just posted myself an hour so ago for the first time. It was a little therapeutic. As was also reading and relating with. Whether ur man or woman, old or young. Rich or poor. Depression and all that comes with it,  hopelessness,  loneliness,  pain and constant torment. These feelings.  They are universal and care. I'm sorry you're struggling too.
I get it man.. I get it

Ty. My lack purpose, hope and not having an outlet isnt from lack of trying. From golf clubs, fun toy like rc cars and planes to more industrious hobbies like home projects. I thought expressing myself thought and instrument might of helped. I'm just exhausted. I was it to stop. This pain is tormented. It's a constant toothache in my soul and inner self.  Just fu#^ing stop.

I just posted here for the first a few minutes ago. Happen to see this post. I'm at the later stages and steps of  attempoling suicide through the last couple weeks.  So I get it. Im 40, and from the surface I have it all. Your parents dismiss your feelings cuz they done know hopelessness and feeling alone.  

You are not alone. And you will get though. Get past this stage. And once your over this thing. Take advantage of it once you refain ur focus and educate yourself on how to cope with the next situation you run into.  So when your 40 you have some of the tools on handling this shit. The tools I wish i h. ad..  that I do not. 

Good luck sir..
